profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: This is what supporters see on your public page — your link, your name and where your journey is heading.
profile.unavailable: Profile settings aren't available right now. Please try again shortly.

language.label: Language
language.help: Used across BuyMeATee on this device.

cover.label: Cover image
cover.help: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. A landscape photo works best — around 1600 × 1067 px (3:2). Keep the main subject roughly centred: the edges are trimmed to fit phones and wider screens.

errors.type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

photo.label: Photo
photo.help: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB. Your photo is public — it appears on your page for anyone to see.

errors.type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

form.usernameHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. This is the link supporters visit to buy you a tee.
form.usernameChangeWarning: Saving changes your public link. Anywhere you shared buymeatee.com/t/{username} will stop working.
form.bioPlaceholder: Where your golf journey is heading, and what support helps you do.
form.aboutPlaceholder:
Tell your story. e.g. “Hi, I’m Simon, the developer behind Caddie Live…”

form.aboutHelp: Supports Markdown — headings, bold, lists and links. People back people, so make it personal.
form.pinnedHelp: Feature one thing near the top of your page — a YouTube video, an Instagram post, or any link.
form.saved: Profile saved. Your page is live at:
form.liveShareNote: 🎉 Help people discover your journey — a quick post goes a long way.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Receiving Tees runs on Stripe. Stripe may ask for identity or bank information — that's part of keeping payments safe.
payments.unavailable: Payment settings aren't available right now. Please try again shortly.
payments.footnote: Payouts are handled by Stripe, not BuyMeATee. A gift being paid means it reached your Stripe account — payout timing to your bank follows your Stripe payout schedule.

notStarted.heading: Payments not set up
notStarted.body: To receive Tees, connect a Stripe account. Stripe handles identity checks, bank details and payouts — BuyMeATee never holds your money.

onboardingNotStarted.heading: Stripe account created
onboardingNotStarted.body: Your Stripe account exists but onboarding hasn't started. It only takes a few minutes.

onboardingIncomplete.heading: Onboarding incomplete
onboardingIncomplete.body: Stripe still needs a few details before you can receive Tees. Pick up where you left off.

informationRequired.heading: Stripe needs more information
informationRequired.body: Stripe has asked for additional information. Until it's provided, payments or payouts may be limited.

verificationPending.heading: Verification in progress
verificationPending.body: Your details are submitted and Stripe is verifying them. This usually completes quickly — check back soon.

ready.heading: Ready to receive Tees
ready.body: Your Stripe account is fully set up. Gifts go directly to your Stripe account and Stripe pays out to your bank on its schedule.

paymentsRestricted.heading: Payments restricted
paymentsRestricted.body: Stripe has restricted this account, so it can't receive Tees at the moment. Open your Stripe dashboard for details, or contact Stripe support.

payoutsDisabled.heading: Payouts disabled
payoutsDisabled.body: Payments are possible but payouts to your bank are currently disabled. Stripe usually needs updated bank or identity details.

connect.countryHelp: Set once and can't be changed later — it fixes your payout currency.
